STOCK EXCHANGE ANNOUNCEMENT - FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Re: Results of Annual General Meeting
The Directors of the Company wish to announce that the Annual General Meeting (the "AGM") of the Company was held on 16th September, 2026.
All of the Resolutions detailed in the Notice of AGM dated 4th August, 2026 were approved at the AGM.
